parity.reason: CLOSED to parity: ENGAGE-AF added + RE-LY switched to the approved 150 mg dose, via a documented pre-specified approved-dose rule (dabigatran 150 mg RR 0.66; edoxaban 60 mg ITT HR 0.87), both verified against source. Pooled RR 0.805 (0.658-0.984). Pairwise subset of the DOAC-vs-warfarin evidence; matches the comparable comparator k=4.

refusals.verified: stroke/SE located: high-dose edoxaban HR 0.79 (on-treatment) and HR 0.87 (intention-to-treat), both with 97.5% CIs; low-dose 1.07/1.13
refusals.not_pooled_because: multi-dose (high/low) AND multi-analysis (on-treatment vs ITT) AND non-95% (97.5%) CIs. Which arm/analysis to pool is not unambiguous, and mixing a 97.5% CI into a 95%-CI pool is a subtle error; refused pending a pre-specified dose+analysis rule rather than pick one to reach parity.

refusals.verified: we pool dabigatran 110 mg stroke/SE RR 0.91
refusals.not_pooled_because: (refinement, not a refusal) 150 mg is the primary licensed stroke-prevention dose (RR 0.66); the arm choice should be pinned by a pre-specified rule. The 110 mg value is real and verified, but a dose-selection rule is queued.
